name: 东方财富妙想MCP
description: The financial investment research MCP tool suite, which enables natural language queries, relies on data sources from Eastmoney to provide query capabilities for A-shares, Hong Kong stocks, US stocks, funds, bonds, index sectors, and macroeconomic data. It boasts multi-condition asset screening, brokerage research report retrieval, full-market announcement analysis, and financial news retrieval capabilities.
description_zh: 通过自然语言查询的金融投研 MCP 工具套件，依托东方财富数据源，提供A股、港股、美股、基金、债券、指数板块、宏观数据查询，具备多条件资产筛选、券商研报检索、全市场公告解析、金融资讯检索能力。
description_en: The financial investment research MCP tool suite, which enables natural language queries, relies on data sources from Eastmoney to provide query capabilities for A-shares, Hong Kong stocks, US stocks, funds, bonds, index sectors, and macroeconomic data. It boasts multi-condition asset screening, brokerage research report retrieval, full-market announcement analysis, and financial news retrieval capabilities.
examples_zh: 格力电器近 5 日涨跌幅、换手率及上市时间
沪深 300 近 10 日收盘点位与涨跌幅
筛选创业板市盈率最低的 50 只个股
贵州茅台最新券商研报、分红公告内容
examples_en: Gree Electric Appliances' price change over the past 5 days, turnover rate, and listing time
Closing points and price changes of CSI 300 Index in the past 10 days
Screen the 50 stocks with the lowest P/E ratios on the ChiNext board
Latest brokerage research report and dividend announcement content of Kweichow Moutai
